scenes.headline: How differential attention subtracts its own noise
scenes.sub: Two softmax maps per head, and the difference between them.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Rooibos! Softmax attention can never give a token exactly zero weight. The Differential Transformer lets a head subtract. Here's how.

scenes.text: Each head computes two softmax maps and returns their difference, so it can give irrelevant tokens zero or negative weight.
scenes.say: The idea: each head computes two attention maps and returns their difference. So it can give an irrelevant token zero weight, or even negative weight.

steps.say: In the paper's retrieval test, a normal transformer puts just point zero three of its attention on the answer, and far more on the rest.
The differential version puts point three one on the answer. Look closely: some of its context bars dip below zero.
Split each head's queries and keys into two groups. Each group makes its own ordinary softmax map over the same tokens.

steps.note: a row now sums to 1 − λ
steps.say: Subtract lambda times the second map from the first. Where the maps agree, weight cancels. Some weights even go negative, which softmax could never do.
Apply the result to the shared values, then normalise each head. The norm turns a quieter background into a louder answer.

left.title: Differential amplifier
items: Both wires pick up the same interference
Common mode is set by the wiring
left.say: The paper compares it to a differential amplifier, where both wires pick up the same interference by construction.

right.title: Differential attention
items: Maps share noise only if trained to
Independent noise adds instead of cancelling
right.say: Two attention maps share their noise only if training makes them. With independent noise, subtraction makes things worse.

scenes.title: Multi-needle retrieval at 64K, average accuracy
scenes.say: And it pays off. At sixty-four thousand tokens, multi-needle retrieval averages point five two for the transformer, and point eight six for the differential one.

scenes.text: Softmax can only make weights small. Subtraction lets a head make them zero, if training teaches both maps the noise.
scenes.mark: if training teaches both maps the noise
scenes.say: Softmax can only make weights small. Subtraction lets a head make them zero, if training teaches both maps the noise.

recap: Two softmax maps per head, one subtracted
Weights can reach zero or go negative
The cancellation is learned, not wired in
scenes.say: To recap: two maps, one subtracted, so weights can reach zero. And the cancellation is learned, not wired in.
